label: Bodleian Library MS. Fraser 73

metadata.label: Catalogue Description
metadata.value: Full catalogue record in Fihrist: Union Catalogue of Manuscripts from the Islamicate World

metadata.label: Place of Origin
metadata.value: Shīrāz, dar Āsitānah-ʼi Ḥaḍrat-i Mawlānā Ḥusām al-Dīn Ibrāhīm

metadata.label: Description
metadata.value: 1 copy of Kullīyāt-i Saʻdī by Saʻdī.

metadata.label: Contents Note
metadata.value: Folio 2b contains the minuscule signature of Rūzbihān the Illuminator على يد العبد روزبهان المذهب.

metadata.label: Hand
metadata.value: Very small, distinct, and clear Nastaʻlīq.

metadata.label: Decoration
metadata.value: Two richly coloured pictures at the beginning; the first two pages of the text most luxuriously adorned in blue and gold; all the headings throughout beautifully illuminated.

metadata.label: Record Origin
metadata.value: Manuscript description based on: Beeston, A. F. L. (Alfred Felix Landon); Ethé, Hermann, 1844-1917.; Sachau, Eduard, 1845-1930; Catalogue of the Persian, Turkish, Hindûstânî, and Pushtû manuscripts in the Bodleian Library, Oxford; at the Clarendon Press 1889-1953.

metadata.label: Related Items
metadata.value: First of three volumes. Second volume: MS. Fraser 74, third volume: Ms. Fraser 75.
